title: name the golden files in the UI-pass brief when a slice adds CLI goldens, so the pass reads them instead of writing an overlay test

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The ui reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261122-025921-2e6a, project ork, item S434:

name the golden files in the UI-pass brief when a slice adds CLI goldens, so the pass reads them instead of writing an overlay test

Evidence: the brief named only TestRenderCLIViews (status, show, help), and doctor views needed an overlay test in the temp dir
